retrieval_cautions: Attempted PMLR li26h was an unrelated paper and was excluded; correct HiddenBench record is li26ej.
Guessed arXiv MasRouter v3/v4 do not exist; abs record establishes v1; v1 was inspected.
Guessed modern ACL HotpotQA identifier failed; correct official identifier D18-1259 used.
AgentWebBench HTML date conflicts with arXiv submission date; both recorded.
UnCoBench v1 and HiddenBench v3 were initially read, then updated to v2 and v4 after metadata checks.
MuSiQue and HotpotQA receive metadata/abstract-level provenance checks only; no full-PDF audit.
No experiment results were reproduced and no paid model calls were made.
Search coverage cannot establish absence of an exact prior study or publication novelty.
gate_reopen_if: An exact matched private-versus-peer receiver source-access interaction is found, or source necessity cannot be independently qualified.
